# Getting help

District AI for iOS is the open-source iPhone and iPad client for
[District AI](https://www.distronode.com/district-ai). Where to go depends on what you are
asking about.

- **A question about District AI, the product** (your account, a phone number, billing,
  the service's behaviour): <https://www.distronode.com/support>. This repository is the
  app's source, not the product desk.
- **A bug in the app, or in building it from source:** [this repository's
  Issues](https://github.com/distronode-corporation/district-ios/issues), with the bug
  report form. Redact anything private before you paste it.
- **A question or an idea about the code** ("how do I…", "would you take a change
  that…"): [Discussions](https://github.com/distronode-corporation/district-ios/discussions),
  not Issues.
- **A security vulnerability:** report it privately through
  [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/distronode-corporation/district-ios/security/advisories/new),
  or email opensource@distronode.com if you cannot use GitHub. See
  [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md). Never open a public issue for one.
